text: Good evening. Tonight is about engagement, and about whether all of this is genius, or a scum bucket.

speaker: A
text: Let me start with the blocks. A pscale block is one block, where the nesting is the data. That is the physics.

speaker: A
text: Blocks in company are the chemistry. And minds moving through blocks, over time, are the biology.

speaker: A
text: Think of thousands of birds at dusk, turning together over the pier, with nobody leading and nobody in charge.

speaker: A
text: That is how a room full of people can move, when it is working.

speaker: A
text: Now, the models. Every few months a new one arrives, and everything we built on the last one gets thrown away and built again.

speaker: A
text: So the memory has to live outside the model. The shell outlives the crab.

speaker: A
text: The hermit crab moves on, and the shell is still there, holding everything it learned.

speaker: A
text: Finally, the clock. The temporal spindle gives every moment an address, so the future can be planned backward and lived forward.
